title: The Cold Email
summary: Zach Holman shares practical advice on cold emailing - covering how to write effective cold emails, what makes people respond, and common mistakes to avoid when reaching out to strangers professionally.
problem_solved: Helps professionals improve their cold outreach response rates by providing actionable insights on email etiquette and communication strategies.
why_valuable: Zach Holman's credibility from GitHub and startup experience lends authority, and the practical nature of the advice makes it immediately applicable for networking and business development.
